◆ REG_SFLASH_BOOT_CFG_ID

#define REG_SFLASH_BOOT_CFG_ID   /*lint --e(923, 9078)*/ (*(volatile Ifx_SFLASH_BOOT_CFG_ID*)(0x03400E10u + PPCA_REMAP_OFFSET_0))

E10, 0x9ADC8D08 (SIMPLE_APP) 0x4FBEEF63 (SECURE_APP) 0xECDB4B1F ( EPB ) 0x39B92974 (DUAL_BANK_SIMPLE_APP) 0x77D56A80 (DUAL_BANK_SECURE_APP) 0x4A656DBD (PROT_FW) 0xA155E76E (BOOT_IDLE), no app is expected.

◆ REG_SFLASH_BOOT_BANK_CTR_OFFSET

#define REG_SFLASH_BOOT_BANK_CTR_OFFSET   /*lint --e(923, 9078)*/ (*(volatile Ifx_SFLASH_BOOT_BANK_CTR_OFFSET*)(0x03400E14u + PPCA_REMAP_OFFSET_0))

E14, An offset from a start of a Flash bank (for flash dual-bank mode) to a 32-bit counter that indicates the valid bank.

Each flash bank must contain this counter. This counter is updated by DFU. Flash bank is selected to be the lower address range (a start of flash address) if: It has a valid counter. Its counter value is bigger than for the other flash-bank, if both counters are valid.

For each dual-bank counter, bits [31:16] should be a fixed value (0x5A3C), otherwise counter is invalid.

◆ REG_SFLASH_BOOT_AUTH

#define REG_SFLASH_BOOT_AUTH   /*lint --e(923, 9078)*/ (*(volatile Ifx_SFLASH_BOOT_AUTH*)(0x03400E1Cu + PPCA_REMAP_OFFSET_0))

E1C, What will be authenticated, or moved from a Shared Secondary Slot after a DFU update.

0x16FF363E (BOOT_AUTH_ALL_MOVE) - Authenticate all images, move from a shared secondary slot on a successful DFU update. 0xEAE22644 (BOOT_AUTH_ALL) - Authenticate all images. 0xFE2D5368 (BOOT_AUTH_ONE) - Authenticate the first image, ignore the other images. 0x71EC07DB (BOOT_AUTH_NONE) - Disable all authentications for LCS=NORMAL_P when ASSET_HASH is not computed. In other cases an invalid combination. Other - invalid.

#define REG_SFLASH_PC_CTL_VALID   /*lint --e(923, 9078)*/ (*(volatile Ifx_SFLASH_PC_CTL_VALID*)(0x03400E49u + PPCA_REMAP_OFFSET_0))

E49, 4-bit Bitfield - Bits 0-1 are unused, Bits 2-3 control PC2-3 handlers.

1 = PCx can only be entered via PCx interrupt handler (Sets CM33_PC_CTL.VALID[bit x] = 1)

0 = PCx is not 'special'. PC may be switched to this value without CM33_PCx_HANDLER interrupt vector

When Protected FW is active, bit 2 cannot be set from OEM policy
